_note: Appendix-C applicability classification (R3). ADOPTION SIGNAL, NOT a quality ranking: `essential` answers 'should almost every Governed Engineering Environment contain this?'; `specialized` means 'valuable when the problem domain requires it' — a specialized mechanism is domain-triggered, not lesser. Curated (declared judgment), keyed by bare catalogue-entry slug; each carries a one-line `why`. Consumed at build time by book/build_book.py:_load_brick_applicability() to render the fourth brick chip (Family · Primary-concern · Enforcement · Applicability) as a tag, never a brick-size change (R6). The drift lint book-models/lint_brick_metadata.py asserts every catalogue slug appears here AND in brick-metadata.json, so a new entry cannot ship without a concern + applicability call. Source of the verdicts: book/_design/drafts/appendix-c-feedback/ (applicability-DRAFT.json + technique-vs-mechanism.md).
